meta.title: Show awarded bids on the proposal
gaps: Prove that non-awarded vendor lines are excluded, because the prepared proposal has only one vendor and one line item.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Prove that non-awarded vendor lines are excluded, because the prepared proposal has only one vendor and one line item.

steps.note: Open the existing submitted award proposal directly, as required for the prepared proposal state.
Enable the proposal filter for awarded bids.
Confirm the Show awarded bids control is enabled.
Verify that the filtered proposal still renders awarded bid line data.
Verify the displayed awarded vendor name.
Verify the awarded line quantity is displayed.
Verify the awarded line amount is displayed.
